lines.text: AMD data center revenue +97% to $8.5B; MI455X ships; Helios racks online at labs
Apple opens Siri AI to all developers in iOS 27.3 beta; App Store submissions in spring
Kimi K3.1 Pro weights still not on Hugging Face on Nov 4; Moonshot still says by today

feed.headline: AMD Q3: revenue $13.4B; data center a record $8.5B, up 97%
feed.why: DC now 64% of sales. Q4 guide about $17B ±3%, non-GAAP GM about 55%. Instinct + EPYC led.

feed.headline: AMD ships MI455X in volume; Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI run first Helios racks
feed.why: Su on the call. Helios to ramp in Q4 as HPE, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro and others ship systems.

feed.headline: Apple opens Siri AI to any developer in iOS 27.3 beta
feed.why: App Intents + skills. App Store submissions open in spring. Daily usage limits restated; paid access later.

feed.headline: Apple Intelligence enters China developer beta with Qwen inside Siri
feed.why: Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence too. No Siri AI in China. Public release expected in December.

feed.headline: Tencent launches Hy4 (vision + computer use); weights in coming days
feed.why: Another big Chinese open-weight promise. No Artificial Analysis or Epoch score yet.

feed.headline: NYT: Anthropic aims to double compute to over 7 GW in 2027
feed.why: About 3.5 GW by year-end. Sits behind the ~$895B commitments already on the S-1/A.

feed.headline: Artificial Analysis moves speed headline to Time per Task; CritPt regrade
feed.why: Methodology change only. Gemini 4 Carbon High still #1 on Index v5 at 59.

feed.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights still absent on Hugging Face on Nov 4
feed.why: Moonshot promised by Nov 4. Newest moonshotai repo is still Kimi-K3 (2 Sep). Watch Beijing EOD.
